This is batch 1

Ran comms_history.py (store-orders skill)
Used the store-orders skill

You're right, you're in Wave 1. Batch 1 slipped at the manufacturer, and we wrote to you on September 27 with the new date, October 31. That's still the date, and your Power Kit and Duster ship in the same box.

Worth whitelisting us so that tracking mail doesn't land in spam. Anything else on it?
Your wrote to inform me of a delayed shipping only 4 days before it was scheduled to ship, to tell me it's a month delayed?
Ran dispute_check.py (order-swap skill)

You're right, and that's not good enough. Four days' notice on a month's slip is late notice, and I'm sorry. The batch sat with the manufacturer longer than they told us.

Where it stands: October 31 for the 40T, Power Kit and Duster together. That email also locked your price at $649 and carried a $50 code for a future order, both still yours.

If the new date doesn't work for you, tell me and I'll go through the options.
Is it possible it will ship before October 31?
Ran warehouse.py (store-orders skill)

It could, but I won't pretend it's likely. The units aren't at our warehouse yet, so October 31 is the date I'd plan around. If the batch lands early and ships sooner, you'll get the tracking email the moment it moves.

I won't give you a better date than the one I can stand behind.
Okay thank you, good bye
Used the chat-interview skill

Thanks for being patient with it. October 31 is the date, and the tracking mail comes to you the moment it moves.

Before you go, one thing: how does it sit with you that newer batches of the 40T have gone on sale while you're still waiting on Wave 1?

As long as orders are filled in the order they are completed I'm fine with that. If there's already finished miners at the manufacturer but they are waiting for more to be completed before shipping to the warehouses, then that's not good business.

Fair position, and Wave 1 is first in line when the batch lands.

You ordered the 40T a week after the Thor P2. What made you step up to the bigger unit so soon after?
It checked all the boxes for what I wanted.
Good to know, thanks for telling me. I'll leave you to it, and you'll hear from us when it ships.
